findings.summary: Server saves restamp a notebook's host grant only under the server's own root (stamping.rs). Grants are per (root, path), so the same file's grant under another root is dropped by the person's or an agent's own edits. The common setup is the Mac app's server at / alongside `ganymede mcp`, `ganymede serve` or `ganymede grant` in a project directory. The CLI side already handles multiple roots (roots_with_id); the server side should too.
findings.source: https://github.com/tlockney/ganymede/pull/827 (GitHub review of 319be0b, Review: changes needed; Gaps entry 17)
